scenarios.name: Load probe: --plugin-dir overrides the installed craftflow
scenarios.given: an empty scratch project with a .craftflow/state dir, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointing at the scratch project
scenarios.when: claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/craftflow --model haiku --debug-file <file> runs a one-word prompt
scenarios.then: the debug log contains 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' at least once, proving the worktree plugin (not the installed one) is what the live scenarios exercise
scenarios.command: SCR=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$SCR/p1/.craftflow/state" && PLUGIN="$PWD/plugins/craftflow" && (cd "$SCR/p1" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$SCR/p1" claude -p --plugin-dir "$PLUGIN" --model haiku --debug-file "$SCR/dbg.txt" "Reply OK" >/dev/null 2>&1); N=$(grep -c 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' "$SCR/dbg.txt"); rm -rf "$SCR"; echo "load_probe_hits=$N"; test "$N" -ge 1

scenarios.name: Round-trip LV-1..LV-6 against the real CLI
scenarios.given: the worktree plugin loaded via --plugin-dir and a scratch plugin copy with contextNudge on, warnTokens 1000, criticalTokens 100000000, assumedWindow 200000000
scenarios.when: context_nudge_roundtrip.py drives real haiku sessions through default audit (LV-1), the warn nudge reaching the model once (LV-2), critical escalation (LV-3), /compact reset without a stale re-nudge (LV-4), the --boundary relay against the live transcript (LV-5) and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID parity (LV-6)
scenarios.then: the driver prints the summary JSON with load_probe PASS and evidence_class A, every lv PASS or the allowed LIMITATION for lv4/lv6, and exits 0

scenarios.name: Timing on the largest real transcript
scenarios.given: the largest *.jsonl under ~/.claude/projects (hundreds of MB), a temp plugin root and project in audit mode, and a real-size activeContext.md
scenarios.when: context_nudge_timing.py times in-process current_context_tokens x50, 20 interleaved bare-vs-hook subprocess runs and 10 --boundary audit runs
scenarios.then: delta_median_ms < 50, inproc_median_ms < 50, boundary_median_ms < 1000 and boundary_max_ms < 2600; the driver exits 0 and never prints transcript content
scenarios.expected: exit 0; gate_pass true with all four gate numbers under budget
